name: fast-composite-jdt
description: Fast Gradle composite-build to JDT adapter with cached named composite roots and instant model switching.

commands.title: Fast Composite JDT: Resync Java Model
Fast Composite JDT: Add Composite Root
Fast Composite JDT: Switch Composite Root
Fast Composite JDT: Remove Composite Root
Fast Composite JDT: Show Model Status
Fast Composite JDT: Clear Cached Model

fastCompositeJdt.autoSyncOnFirstOpen.description: Run Gradle model extraction only when no cached model exists. Cached startups do not invoke Gradle.

fastCompositeJdt.gradleArguments.description: Additional arguments passed to the Gradle wrapper during model resync.

fastCompositeJdt.disableJdtGradleImport.description: Set java.import.gradle.enabled=false at workspace scope so Red Hat Java does not run its Gradle importer.

fastCompositeJdt.attachCachedSources.description: Attach matching *-sources.jar files found beside Gradle cache artifacts when available.
